title: Princess of Wales speaks about impact of cancer diagnosis in BBC film Heal
summary_full: Documentary records Catherine taking on Three Peaks challenge and finding ‘sense of hope alongside uncertainty’The Princess of Wales has spoken candidly about the impact of her cancer diagnosis in a BBC documentary to be aired later this month.“Cancer does change you,” Catherine, 44, says in the trailer for the 30-minute programme. “It changes your body. It changes you physically, but there’s a much, much deeper part to what a cancer diagnosis shifts in you.” Continue reading...
